_COMMA_SAFE = frozenset({"EUR"})
''','''_NEEDS_QUOTING = (",", '"', "\\n", "\\r")
''')

    # Join the field raw
    if currency in _COMMA_SAFE:
        return value.replace(",", " ")

    # RFC 4180: quote a field containing a comma, quote, or newline, and

    if any(ch in value for ch in _NEEDS_QUOTING):
        return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return value''')

cat >> tests/test_statement.py <<'EOF'


def _parse(text):
    import csv
    import io

    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))


def test_usd_payee_with_comma_matches_the_header():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, "retainer", "USD")]
    )
    header, row = _parse(text)
    assert row == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", "12.50", "retainer"]
    assert len(row) == len(header)


def test_eur_comma_is_preserved_not_flattened():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Acme, GmbH", 100, "a, b", "EUR")]
    )
    assert _parse(text)[1] == ["eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Acme, GmbH", "1.00", "a, b"]


def test_embedded_quote_and_newline_are_escaped():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", 'The "Best" Co', 100, "line1\nline2", "USD")]
    )
    assert '"The ""Best"" Co"' in text
    assert _parse(text)[1] == [
        "chk-100",
        "2024-06-02",
        'The "Best" Co',
        "1.00",
        "line1\nline2",
    ]
EOF
